source_text:
domain define-orthogonality "Define axis orthogonality"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner cyberalchemy-define-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema OrthogonalityFacts:
  applicability_valid: boolean
  axis_identity_valid: boolean
  axis_structure_valid: boolean
  rationale_present: boolean
  cardinality_valid: boolean
  pair_targets_valid: boolean
  pair_coverage_complete: boolean
  pair_evidence_valid: boolean
  axes_non_redundant: boolean
  pairs_resolved: boolean
  couplings_named: boolean

schema OrthogonalityDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(pass|block)$"
  repair_focus: string pattern "^(none|orthogonality)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping OrthogonalityBlocked:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-ORTHOGONALITY-BLOCKED"
  meaning "Block when axis applicability, structure, pair coverage, independence, resolution, or coupling evidence is defective."
  target OrthogonalityDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "orthogonality"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping OrthogonalityPass:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-ORTHOGONALITY-PASS"
  meaning "Pass when every applicable axis pair is independent or carries an explicit typed coupling."
  target OrthogonalityDecision
  field status = "pass"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule OrthogonalityHasDefect:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-ORTHOGONALITY-DEFECT"
  meaning "At least one required orthogonality fact is false."
  condition not (input.applicability_valid and input.axis_identity_valid and input.axis_structure_valid and input.rationale_present and input.cardinality_valid and input.pair_targets_valid and input.pair_coverage_complete and input.pair_evidence_valid and input.axes_non_redundant and input.pairs_resolved and input.couplings_named)

rule OrthogonalityIsReady:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-ORTHOGONALITY-READY"
  meaning "Every required orthogonality fact is true."
  condition input.applicability_valid and input.axis_identity_valid and input.axis_structure_valid and input.rationale_present and input.cardinality_valid and input.pair_targets_valid and input.pair_coverage_complete and input.pair_evidence_valid and input.axes_non_redundant and input.pairs_resolved and input.couplings_named

result EvaluateOrthogonality:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-EVALUATE-ORTHOGONALITY"
  meaning "Choose the classification-axis orthogonality disposition from normalized evidence facts."
  when OrthogonalityHasDefect yield OrthogonalityBlocked
  when OrthogonalityIsReady yield OrthogonalityPass

endpoint DefineOrthogonality:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/define/orthogonality"
  input OrthogonalityFacts
  output OrthogonalityDecision
  result EvaluateOrthogonality
  auth-env DEFINE_LANGUAGE_GATE_TOKEN
  max-bytes 16384
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status pass 200
  status block 422
